title.text: Training: learn Voice Verses on the real screens

how.text:
How it fits together

• Set up your booth opens by itself the first time Voice Verses starts. Training holds it afterwards.

• Every lesson runs on the real screens. Purple band: practice, nothing reaches the projector, stream, stage or ProPresenter. Red band: the ProPresenter lesson, which uses ProPresenter for real.

• Show me: a spotlight and a pointer do each step. Let me try: you do it; it waits, hints, and checks the result.

• One short line per step; the explanation is behind “Why?”.

• Every warning has Show me the fix: one thing lit up, seconds, back to the service.

• ProPresenter's steps are pictured, and checked through its network connection.

• Each lesson has its own automatic test, so a change to the screens can't break a lesson unnoticed.

• Later: picture guides to share, and progress by person.
